property: DNSSEC adds new resource-record types and validation/protocol behavior while preserving the DNS namespace, delegation, query and typed-RR core.

sources.supports: DNSSEC updates rather than obsoletes RFC 1034/1035 and adds new RR types/protocol modifications

negative_claims: This edge does not claim the RFC 4033 generation was the first DNS security design; it replaced earlier DNSSEC documents.
It does not claim ordinary DNS data becomes confidential.
open_questions: Reconstruct RFC 2535 predecessor generation and root signing deployment.
notes: Security graft onto a durable typed-record architecture.
